releaseNotes:
﻿## Updates

- Client updates no longer fail the production build with "duplicate column name: revision" when Next.js workers migrate the database in parallel

## Reports

- Corrupt monthly report data is no longer treated as a blank report; the saved data is left unchanged and an error is shown instead

## Also in 0.6.4 (if you skipped it)

- Weekly and monthly show participant arrival/departure travel on the correct days, including early arrivals and late departures
